# renaname file to ci.yml
name: CI

on:
  push:
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  tests:
    name: ${{ matrix.os }} / ${{ matrix.compiler }} / ${{ matrix.preset }}
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - { os: ubuntu-latest, compiler: g++, preset: debug }
          - { os: ubuntu-latest, compiler: g++, preset: asan }
          - { os: ubuntu-latest, compiler: g++, preset: ubsan }
          - { os: ubuntu-latest, compiler: clang++, preset: debug }
          - { os: ubuntu-latest, compiler: clang++, preset: asan }
          - { os: ubuntu-latest, compiler: clang++, preset: ubsan }
          - { os: macos-latest, compiler: clang++, preset: debug }
          - { os: macos-latest, compiler: clang++, preset: asan }
          - { os: macos-latest, compiler: clang++, preset: ubsan }
    env:
      CXX: ${{ matrix.compiler }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Configure
        run: cmake --preset "${{ matrix.preset }}"
      - name: Build
        run: cmake --build --preset "${{ matrix.preset }}" --parallel 2
      - name: Test
        run: ctest --preset "${{ matrix.preset }}"
      - name: Run smoke benchmark
        run: ./build/${{ matrix.preset }}/mlab_smoke_bench --benchmark_min_time=0.001s

  clang-tidy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Install clang-tidy
        run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y clang-tidy
      - name: Configure
        run: cmake --preset debug -DCMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS=ON
      - name: Lint project smoke test
        run: clang-tidy -p build/debug tests/unit/core_smoke_test.cpp
